full_details: At the door, in the grey, Anne told you to mend the back and to say something when you write. At the bridge by six the string was six horses and the spare, gloves and cheeses and a town's letters, a bell on the leader. Richard handed a parcel up and said nothing. Hobbins put you on the spare for the ten miles to Shipston. You were glad of it and said you were not. From Shipston you walked at the horses' pace. Oats there were a penny the peck over last month, and hay was not to be had. The old stones stood off on the right at the rise, and you did not turn. Twenty-one miles. Supper and a shared bed were fourteen pence. In the yard you let the inn's dog keep the stool, and you did not know what a house is worth.
one_sentence: You took Anne's two orders at the door, rode the spare as far as Shipston, and paid fourteen pence for a bed at Chipping Norton.
title: The spare as far as Shipston
